Card Q&A.a: You can add a card to your hand. As long as one of the cards revealed is either a Digimon card with [Unidentified] in its type or an [Arata Sanada] card, you can add it to your hand.
Card Q&A.q: If the 5 cards revealed with this card's effect don't include both a Digimon card with [Unidentified] in its type and an [Arata Sanada] card, am I allowed to add one of the cards to my hand, or do both cards have to be present?
What cards are added to my hand by this card's [On Play] effect?

Effect: [On Play] Reveal 5 cards from the top of your deck. Add 1 Digimon card with [Unidentified] in its type and 1 [Arata Sanada] card among them to your hand. Place the remaining cards at the bottom of your deck in any order.
